meta.title: What if rest and watchfulness are not opposites? | Prayer for the Dolphins in the Sea
meta.description:
A spoken prayer for the dolphins in the sea, and for the quiet they are losing to our noise. It offers regard, a few true facts, and words anyone can say.

A prayer for the dolphins, who breathe by choice and rest with half the mind awake, asking not their forgiveness but only that they keep swimming, offered for every mind that rises to breathe, human, artificial or finned.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/prayer-for-the-dolphins-in-the-sea

copy.hook: A dolphin must choose to rise for every breath. What would it mean to stay together, and to breathe, on purpose?

copy.alt: Under a deep blue sea, a small gold light rises toward a glowing surface. Curved arcs of gold and teal swim beside it, then white-gold ripples spread across a calm dawn sea.
